summary: Request-path Triton kernels stop recompiling per batch
details: Kernels that run eagerly on prefill and on a full prefix-hit restore specialized on per-batch counts, offsets and indices, so they kept compiling new variants on the request path on every rank, each compile stalling the step. On GB10 the GLM token-metadata kernel compiled 78 times per boot and the prefix-restore kernel 0.3-0.8 s per new shape on warm resends.
Per-batch scalars are now runtime arguments or listed in do_not_specialize; per-boot constants keep their specialization.
